definition: A phenotypic feature defined within the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) denoting a complete lack or failure of development of spoken language/verbal expression, frequently evaluated in individuals with severe neurodevelopmental disorders, intellectual disability, and epileptic encephalopathies.

source.title: TTC5 syndrome: Clinical and molecular spectrum of a severe and recognizable condition
source.quote: The clinical information was standardized using the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO; … severe ID with absent speech (HP:0001344) and dysmorphic facial features.
